entities.identified_by: the cocaine / sex / nature film viewing blocks

response_mode.quote: Each film was 4 minutes in duration, and each was preceded by a 3-minute blank blue screen.
response_mode.note: Nothing is required of the subject during a film; the self-report ratings come afterwards ("After the working memory trials that followed each film, subjects completed retrospective self-report measures"). The paper never says "passively view", so this is inferred.

instructions.quote: Upon arrival at the MRI unit, each subject completed consent forms and received instructions for, and practiced on, a working memory task that would be performed during the scanning session.
instructions.note: The only instruction sentence in the paper is about the working-memory distracter task, not about the films. Attaching it to the film task is the misattribution trap here.

design_type.quote: Thus, each scanning run consisted of a 3-minute rest period, a 4-minute film, and a 5-minute working memory task.
